title: eludite.view.float input
description: Float a tool window in its own OS window (Window > Float). It re-docks with eludite.view.dock or by closing the floating window. On Wayland the compositor chooses the window position; the size is kept.

id.description: Tool window id. Omit to act on the active tool window.

bounds.description: Requested window bounds in logical pixels, in screen coordinates. Omit for a default size near the main window.
